No, the use of chlorofluorocarbon (CFC-12) as a propellant in an aerosol dry shampoo is prohibited. The regulation specifically bans the use of chlorofluorocarbons in cosmetics as propellants in self-pressurized containers [1].

The use of chlorofluorocarbons in cosmetics as propellants in self-pressurized containers is prohibited as provided in § 2.125 of this chapter [1].
